notes: SplitsWarehouse is a central ERC6909 ledger; token id = uint256(uint160(token)); native ETH uses the 0xEeee sentinel and raw ETH balances. All value movement flows through deposit/withdraw/batchTransfer/batchDeposit.

PullSplit distributes via warehouse accounting (batchTransfer + distributor transfer); PushSplit distributes via direct token/ETH transfers with a warehouse-deposit fallback for failed ETH sends. Both leave 1 wei in wallet and warehouse.

Split wallets are minimal-proxy clones (Clone.sol, custom receive path emitting ReceiveETH); implementation FACTORY is the deploying factory contract; initialize() is factory-only and unreachable twice (factory returns early for deployed addresses).

Split owner is fully trusted: updateSplit, execCalls (arbitrary calls, per-iteration ownership re-check per H-02 fix), setPaused. Owner == address(0) means immutable; no owner recovery exists for immutable splits.

Warehouse withdrawal incentives are opt-in per owner (WithdrawConfig.incentive, uint16, max ~6.5%); batch withdraw pays the incentive to a caller-chosen withdrawer and always reverts when paused; single-token withdraw bypasses incentives and sends everything to the owner, with a tx.origin==owner pause bypass.

ERC6909X adds EIP-712 signature approvals (approveBySig, temporaryApproveAndCall[BySig]) with unordered-bitmap nonces; temporary grants restore the prior allowance/operator state after the target callback.

SmartVault is an ERC-4337 v0.7 UUPS account: threshold m-of-n signers (EOA eth-signed-message or WebAuthn passkey); first threshold-1 signers sign a light hash (sender, nonce, calldata hash, gas-limit bounds, entrypoint, chainid), last signer signs the full userOpHash; merkelized variant signs merkle roots. Owner (Solady Ownable) can execute/upgrade directly without threshold signatures — owner supremacy is the documented recovery design (audit 3.2.3).

Modules (ModuleManager) are fully trusted: executeFromModule runs arbitrary calls as the vault, including self-calls that pass onlySelf authorization. Fallback handlers run via plain call (own context, no value forwarded).

AutoEarnModule (unaudited, deployed mainnet 0x2E59620f...): anyone may call deposit(account) which sweeps the account's full ASSET balance (live: USDC) into a fixed ERC4626 VAULT (live: Splits Earn USDC 0xF5730f..., third-party/unverified source, out of monorepo scope) with shares to the account. AutoEarnEnrollerModule enrolls the module on treasuries/sub-accounts; both rely on SmartVault onlyModule + onlyEntryPointOrOwner modifiers.

Post-audit code movement is minimal: splits-v2 src diff V2.2 (#65) -> HEAD is formatting-only; smart-vaults src diff audited dbc09cd -> HEAD is formatting-only; smart-vault-modules is entirely new (Mar-Sep 2026) and unaudited.

Trust boundaries: untrusted callers may call distribute/depositToWarehouse/withdrawFromWarehouse/withdraw/deposit/batch*/temporaryApproveAndCall*/deposit(AutoEarn)/enroll; all move funds only within the target account's own balances or to preconfigured recipients/vaults. No delegatecall to user input; no selfdestruct; tx.origin appears only in the two analyzed pause-bypass checks.
